summary.text: Darrell Issa represents California's 48th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and chaired the Oversight and Government Reform Committee from 2011 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Originally from Ohio, he enlisted in the U.S. Army, graduated from Siena Heights University with a business degree, and was commissioned as an Army officer, reaching the rank of captain before completing active duty in 1980.
He founded and led a California electronics company that made vehicle anti-theft devices, and chaired the Consumer Electronics Association.
